header.title: How to Fix a Washing Machine That Won't Fill With Water
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on troubleshooting and repairing a washing machine that is failing to fill with water. It covers common causes and solutions, from checking hoses to inspecting internal components.

steps.description: This step involves inspecting the washing machine hoses to identify potential issues preventing water from filling.
actions: Check if faucets are turned on
Check if faucets are allowing water to enter
Inspect mesh filters inside where hoses are attached
Check for kinks in the hoses
Check for damage to the hoses

steps.description: This step involves testing the water level switch using a multimeter to diagnose a potential filling issue in the washing machine.
actions: Locate the water level switch (identified by a clear tube).
Set the volt-ohm meter to RX1.
Check all three terminals with the probe, trying all possible pairings.
Observe the meter readings for each pairing.
Replace the water level switch if readings are incorrect.

steps.description: This step involves inspecting and cleaning the filters located on the back of the washing machine to resolve filling issues.
actions: Disconnect the hoses from the back of the unit
Locate the filters on the back of the washer

steps.description: This step involves checking the water inlet valve, water volume selector switch, and control panel buttons to ensure proper function.
actions: Check the water volume selector switch
Ensure the buttons on the control panel are fully depressed
steps.part: Water inlet valve, water volume selector switch, control panel buttons

steps.description: Diagnose a potential blockage in the pressure chamber by observing the washing machine's behavior and determining if it washes and spins without water.
actions: Observe if the machine washes and spins without water

steps.description: If water flow is very slow and hoses/filters are clear, the issue is likely within the house plumbing.
actions: Check for very slow water flow
